sources.officialityEvidence: Published on the official website of Jordan's Ministry of Interior and presented as the Ministry's restricted-nationality schedule.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Restricted Countries: Countries that need prior approval.

sources.title: E-Applications for Visa and Residence Permits
sources.officialityEvidence: Published on Jordan's Ministry of Interior domain and linked to the Ministry's official electronic visa service.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Visa application are accept only if the application was submitted from outside the Kingdom.

sources.title: Visa E Applications
sources.officialityEvidence: The Ministry of Interior's visa-services page links directly to its Visit Visa E-Service and other official electronic applications.

sources.title: User Manual for MOI E-services Site
sources.officialityEvidence: The manual is hosted on Jordan's Ministry of Interior domain and identifies the Ministry's E-Services Site.
sources.supportingExcerpt: After paying the visa fees, a page will appear indicating that the e-Visa has been issued.

policies.title: Jordanian citizenship is outside the foreign visitor-visa schedule
policies.summary: Jordan's restricted and non-restricted foreign-nationality schedule does not establish visitor-visa treatment for a Jordanian passport holder.
conditions: This classification does not determine a dual national's document obligations, Jordanian passport validity, departure restrictions, military-service matters or case-specific border treatment.

policies.title: Jordan nationalities requiring prior visa approval
policies.summary: The Ministry of Interior expressly classifies these 53 nationalities as restricted and requiring prior approval before travel to Jordan.
conditions: The Ministry expressly treats this group as requiring prior approval. Its E-services manual distinguishes their other visa applications from the electronic-visa route for nationalities that do not require prior approval; this is therefore visa_required, not evisa.
The Ministry's schedule is split into 14 Asian, 37 African and two South American nationalities. Its spellings are normalized to the catalog codes without expanding the list.
All travel-pass documents issued by any country are treated as restricted except a travel pass issued by Vatican City; that document rule is not generalized to ordinary Vatican passports.

An application must be submitted from outside Jordan. The Ministry may require an in-person interview at a Jordanian embassy, and its portal supports electronic submission, status inquiry and payment.

This policy does not establish duration, entries, extension, fee, sponsor or guarantee requirements, work, study, transit, residence, diplomatic, official, service, emergency, refugee, stateless or other special-document treatment.

Approval does not itself guarantee admission. Passport validity, purpose, accommodation, funds, onward travel, health, public-order, security and individual admissibility requirements remain applicable.

application.label: Jordan Ministry of Interior Visit Visa E-Service
steps: Register an account with an email address on the Ministry of Interior electronic-services portal.
Select the Visit Visa service and submit the application while outside Jordan.
Track the application through the account and pay the applicable service charge or other requested amount.
Attend a Jordanian embassy interview if the Ministry requests one and retain the electronic application number.
